newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Rate on 91-day Bahrain t-bills down at 5.78 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rate on 91-day Bahrain t-bills down at 5.78 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 10 million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills was down at 5.78 percent from 5.79 last week, a spokesman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price rose to 98.561 from 98.558 and the minimum price accepted was 98.545.
Banks submitted bids for 24.42 million dinars worth of bills, up from 16.3 million dinars a week ago.
The bills, maturing on August 20, were offered on Monday and will be issued on Wednesday.
